main.summary: Provides tenant-scoped Azure Blob Storage for transfer staging, publication assembly, and cleanup.
main.remarks: Staged objects, ranges, chunks, and publication objects are addressed below the transfer session prefix. Upload payloads are read sequentially into one rented 8 MiB in-memory block buffer per active save, hashed as read, staged directly to Azure as uncommitted blocks, then committed with integrity metadata.

field.name: SHA512MetadataKey
field.summary: Metadata key containing the uppercase hexadecimal SHA-512 digest of a blob.

field.name: LengthMetadataKey
field.summary: Metadata key containing the invariant string representation of a blob length.

field.name: StagedBlockSize
field.summary: Maximum in-memory payload buffer used for each uncommitted block.

field.name: MaximumBlockCount
field.summary: Maximum number of committed blocks allowed in a block blob.

field.name: container
field.summary: Blob container used for the tenant item.

field.name: connectionString
field.summary: Connection string used to create block blob clients for the tenant item.

field.name: path
field.summary: Transfer path builder for the current session.

field.name: itemid
field.summary: Published item identifier whose tenant container is being accessed.

constructor.name: TenantTransferStorage
constructor.summary: Initializes tenant transfer storage for a storage silo, transfer session, item, and item instance.
constructor.param: Storage silo containing the tenant connection string.
Transfer session identifier used to construct staging paths.
Published item identifier used to select the blob container.
Item instance token used to isolate the staging paths.
constructor.exception: The silo has no connection string or the item identifier is empty.

method.name: DeleteTransferCoreAsync
method.summary: Deletes all staged blobs below the current transfer prefix.
method.returns: True after the transfer staging artifacts have been removed.

method.name: DeleteInstanceTransfersAsync
method.summary: Deletes every transfer blob under the selected item instance, including prefixes without a persisted session and published artifacts.
method.param: Storage silo containing the tenant connection string.
Published item identifier whose blob container is selected.
Item instance token whose transfer artifacts are removed.
method.returns: True after all artifacts for the item instance are absent.

method.name: SaveVerifiedAsync
method.summary: Streams and hashes a request payload into uncommitted blocks, verifies its declared length and digest, then atomically commits the blocks and metadata.
method.param: Blob name relative to the selected container.
method.returns: A verified staged blob reference, or null when the content does not match the declaration.

method.name: PublishObjectAsync
method.summary: Copies a validated staged object to its published Blob with integrity metadata in the same Azure copy request.
method.remarks: The source copy is conditioned on the ETag whose metadata was validated, and destination creation is conditional to preserve immutable publication behavior.
method.param: Cancellation token for the copy operation.
method.returns: Published artifact reference, or null when validation or copy does not succeed.

method.name: DeleteStagedBlobAsync
method.summary: Attempts idempotent cleanup of a staged blob without masking the original write failure.

method.name: GetVerificationFailureCode
method.summary: Identifies whether an existing staged blob has an invalid length or hash.

method.name: ValidateExpectedLength
method.summary: Validates that the expected payload length matches the logical transfer range.

method.name: SaveAsync
method.summary: Streams a transfer payload into uncommitted Azure Blob blocks, then commits its bytes and content metadata together.
method.remarks: When replacement is disabled, an existing blob is accepted only when its length and SHA-512 digest match the supplied content. A conflicting immutable blob causes an exception.
method.param: Blob name relative to the selected container.
Whether an existing blob may be replaced.
method.returns: The stored blob reference, or null when storage does not return a reference.
method.exception: An immutable existing blob has different content from the supplied payload.

method.name: StagePayloadAsync
method.param: Destination blob for the staged blocks.
Payload stream that computes the digest as bytes are read.
method.returns: Ordered Base64 block identifiers staged for final commit.

method.name: CreateBlockID
method.summary: Creates a deterministic Base64 block identifier from a staging operation identifier and block index.
method.param: Operation identifier shared by all blocks staged for one payload.
Zero-based block index within the staging operation.
method.returns: Base64 block identifier encoded from operation bytes and index.

method.name: CommitPayloadAsync
method.summary: Commits staged blocks and their verified content metadata in one conditional Blob operation; empty payloads use one conditional empty-blob upload.
method.param: SHA-512 digest of the staged bytes.
Whether an existing blob may be replaced.

method.name: SaveFinalAsync
method.summary: Saves a final artifact payload using replacement semantics.
method.param: Blob name relative to the selected container.
method.returns: The stored artifact reference, or null when storage does not return a reference.

method.name: OpenAsync
method.summary: Opens a blob for streaming download.
method.param: Blob name relative to the selected container.
method.returns: The blob content stream, or null when the blob does not exist.

method.name: EnsureContainerAsync
method.summary: Ensures that the tenant item blob container exists.
method.returns: A task representing the container creation check.

method.name: VerifyArtifactAsync
method.summary: Verifies an existing published artifact against its expected length and SHA-512 digest.
method.returns: A verified artifact reference, or null when the metadata does not match.

method.name: GetReferenceAsync
method.summary: Reads the properties of an existing block blob and creates its published artifact reference.
method.param: Existing published artifact blob to inspect.
Cancellation token for the properties request.
method.returns: A reference containing the blob name, content length, and decoded SHA-512 metadata.

method.name: VerifyMetadata
method.summary: Checks the stored blob length and SHA-512 metadata against expected values.
method.param: Blob properties containing the stored length and metadata.
method.returns: True when both the length and digest metadata match.

method.name: CreateUploadOptions
method.summary: Creates upload options with SHA-512 and length metadata and immutable or replacement conditions.
method.param: SHA-512 digest to store as metadata.
Payload length to store as metadata.
Whether the upload may replace an existing blob.

method.name: CreateMetadata
method.summary: Creates the standard integrity and length metadata for a blob.
method.returns: Metadata containing the digest and length.

method.name: ReadHash
method.summary: Reads and validates a SHA-512 digest from blob metadata.
method.returns: The decoded 64-byte digest, or an empty array when metadata is missing or invalid.

method.name: ValidateRange
method.summary: Validates that a transfer range is non-empty and structurally valid.
method.exception: The range is null, invalid, or empty.

method.name: ValidateOperationID
method.summary: Validates that a transfer operation identifier is not empty.

method.name: ValidateBlobReference
method.summary: Validates the name, length, and SHA-512 digest of a tenant blob reference.
method.exception: The reference has an empty name, a negative length, or an invalid digest.

method.name: ValidateBlock
method.summary: Validates a transfer block's identifier, source range, and source bounds.
method.exception: The block identifier, length, source offset, or source bounds are invalid.

method.name: CreateBlockBlob
method.summary: Creates a block blob client for a named blob in the current item container.
method.returns: Block blob client for the named blob.
